subject: RP11 Paper Results — 12/15, 80% — scores file updated
body:

For the dashboard and score display: RP11 entry is now in kai-scores-latest.json under mcm-retake-practice-11 with full per-question breakdown. Section B was 8/8 perfect — that is the strongest Section B result since RP3.

Kai's final exam is today. No further prep actions needed from this team. The build is live, the scores are recorded.
